# Joe Levi

> Personal site for Joe Levi — digital business card and résumé. Cache Valley, Utah. Author of Miles the Muskrat; amateur radio KF7NWA; web, networking, and systems work.

Canonical host is `www.joelevi.com` (apex redirects to www).

## Pages

- [Home (digital business card)](https://www.joelevi.com/): Contact card with Signal, email, phone, résumé, Miles / Mesh / GitHub links, vCard and PGP key download
- [Résumé](https://www.joelevi.com/resume/): Full hResume — experience, education, skills, references & testimonials, recent reading (Amazon Associates links)
